audience: VERIFIER ONLY. The rater must NEVER see this file.

source_of_truth.note: Single-label, mutually-exclusive, quote-anchored demotion role assignments. Per the demotion pre-reg, this is the committed classification and is NOT re-judged by the packet-builder. The rater independently re-adjudicates; agreement vs demotion_role_5class (via mapped_rater_role_3class) IS the per-concept fidelity signal.

mapping_rule.description: Load-bearing collapse of the demotion 5-class role assignment into the rater's 3-class closed taxonomy. Recorded alongside the raw 5-class label so the verifier can re-map if they contest this collapse.
mapping_rule.rationale: gate-strength absorbs JUSTIFIED_MANDATORY (hard gate), OPTIONAL (soft confluence), and ALTERNATIVE (either/or route) — all carry decision weight the trader acts on. context = CONTEXTUAL (scene-setting/narration/UI/refuted-strawman). cannot-determine = UNRESOLVED. This is the strictest defensible reading at freeze time (H1 pre-reg Law-4 preamble): a demoted-but-decision-bearing clause is scored gate-strength, NOT context, so the fidelity check cannot be won by calling every demotion 'context'.
mapping_rule.alternate_reading_flag: If the verifier prefers the STRICT-spine reading (only JUSTIFIED_MANDATORY = gate-strength; OPTIONAL/ALTERNATIVE = context), re-map from demotion_role_5class — both labels are preserved per item.

control_gate.rule: Rater's target calls count iff Set A clears >= 4/5 gate AND >= 4/5 context.
control_gate.controls_drawn_from: unambiguous imperative gates + unambiguous narration in the audited corpus
